Name: Many Hands -  Co-op bonuses for working side by side
Author: EHoop30
Description:
[size=5][b]Features[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]Synergy buff:[/b] standing near a teammate grants a single "Many Hands" buff with small boosts to movement speed, luck, pickup radius, attack, defense, and skill levels. It stacks with each nearby teammate up to a cap.[/*]
[*][b]Lighter work:[/b] your tools drain less stamina while a teammate is beside you.[/*]
[*][b]Bonus yield:[/b] a chance for an extra drop when you gather next to a teammate, covering crops, rocks, ore, geodes, twigs, weeds, and chopped trees.[/*]
[*][b]Proximity based:[/b] every bonus scales with how many teammates are close and switches off when you move apart, so it only applies while you are genuinely working together.[/*]
[*][b]Balanced defaults:[/b] values aim for the "noticeable but not game-breaking" range (roughly 10 to 15 percent), and every one is adjustable.[/*]
[/list][size=5][b]In-game settings[/b][/size]
Press [b]F9[/b] (changeable in config.json) for a built-in settings menu. There is no dependency on any config-menu mod.

[size=5][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6 or later[/*]
[*]SMAPI 4.0.0 or later[/*]
[/list][size=5][b]Installation[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*]Install SMAPI.[/*]
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into your Stardew Valley/Mods folder.[/*]
[*]Run the game through SMAPI (or via steam with launch options configured properly).[/*]
[/list][b]Multiplayer install:[/b] the bonuses are applied on each player's own machine, so every player who wants them needs the mod. A nearby teammate does not need it to count as close. Installing it on everyone is the simplest option.

Manifest.Name: Many Hands
Manifest.Description: Co-op bonuses for working side by side: a synergy buff, lighter work (less stamina drain), and bonus yield (extra drops) when you gather near your teammates.
